Step 1 — src/ratelimit/bucket.py

```python
import time


class TokenBucket:
    """In-process token bucket. Refills at `rate` tokens/sec up to `capacity`."""

    def __init__(self, rate: float, capacity: float) -> None:
        self.rate = rate
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.tokens = capacity
        self._last = time.monotonic()

    def allow(self, now: float) -> bool:
        # Refill based on elapsed wall time (tokens/sec), capped at capacity, then
        # spend one token if any remain.
        elapsed = now - self._last
        self._last = now
        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + elapsed * self.rate)
        if self.tokens >= 1:
            self.tokens -= 1
            return True
        return False
```
